answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 161442 Country: India Title: Is Safiya Rahman for baby girl name correct? Question: I would like to know whether name Safiya Rahman which I named my daughter after consulting with some Mufti from my local Islamic Madrasa on 7th day after born is correct or not? Same day I did aqiqah as well. If the name is correct then it’s okay, else guide me what can be changed. Please advise me if I am wrong. Appreciate your quick turn around on the request. Answer ID: 161442 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 995/781/SN=8/1439) (a) Rahman is among those Beautiful Names that are specified with Allah. (See Fatawa Usmani 1/50, pub. Naimia). So it is not correct to keep this name without adding Abd or Amat. Thus either you keep the name of your daughter only Safiya and do not include Rahman or keep her name Safiya Amatur Rahman. Amatur Rahman means Allah’s slave girl while Safiya is the name of the holy wife of the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him). (b) However, if you keep Safiya Rahman and it is based upon genitive construction that Safiya is mudaf towards Rahman then this name too will be correct. In this case it will mean Allah’s sincere friend. As Safiya also means sincere friend. (See Misbahul Lughat, p. 452) So as per the explanation made above regarding the name it is allowable to keep the name Safiya Rahman. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
